name: intent_ack_refused
note: The unknown_target refusal shape (§5.3/§5.6). This is a well-formed message, not a malformed one: it is an edge vector because the refusal it carries is the one the protocol most warns about turning into an existence oracle. unknown_target means the vendor never issued this token, never that the referent stopped existing — that discovery is act_result/target_gone's monopoly.
